Adamantine Scimitar.name: Adamantine Scimitar

effects.name: Diamondsbane
effects.text: If an adamantine weapon hits an object, the hit is always critical.

effects.name: Lethal Weapon (Slashing)
effects.text: This weapon ignores Resistance to Slashing damage.

grants.name: Flourish
grants.text: Bonus Action; recharges on Short Rest. Feint an attack to possibly leave the target Off Balance.

grants.name: Lacerate
grants.text: Action; recharges on Short Rest. Slash at your target's vital points to make it Bleed.

Adamantine Scimitar.description: Each cut of this blade shines with the wicked glint of adamantine -- a promise for a devastating blow.

Adamantine Shield.name: Adamantine Shield

effects.text: Attackers cannot land critical hits on the wearer.

effects.name: Adamantine Shield
effects.text: When a melee attack misses the wearer, the attacker becomes Reeling for 2 turns.

grants.name: Shield Bash
grants.text: Reaction. When a foe hits you with a melee attack, knock the attacker Prone unless it succeeds a saving throw.

Adamantine Shield.description: The dull shine of the adamantine promises this shield could take a thousand beatings -- and still look as good as new.

Amulet of Restoration.name: Amulet of Restoration

grants.name: Healing Word
grants.text: Level 1 spell; Bonus Action; once per Long Rest

grants.name: Mass Healing Word
grants.text: Level 3 spell; Bonus Action; once per Long Rest

Amulet of Restoration.description: The gemstone centrepiece of the amulet was long ago mottled and dyed by the tears of a martyr.

Amulet of the Devout.name: Amulet of the Devout

effects.name: High Spellcasting (+2)
effects.text: You gain a +2 bonus to Spell Save DC.

effects.name: Godswill
effects.text: You gain an additional use of Channel Divinity Charge. Once used, it is restored upon taking a Long Rest.

Amulet of the Devout.description: Otto, a member of the powerful arcane organisation the Circle of Eight, had a penchant for amulets…

Amulet of the Harpers.name: Amulet of the Harpers

effects.text: The wearer has Advantage on Wisdom saving throws.

grants.name: Shield
grants.text: Level 1 spell; Reaction; once per Long Rest

Amulet of the Harpers.description: Nobility can be found in suffering the slings and arrows of outrageous fortune. So can dying. Best to be on guard.

Armour of Moonbasking.name: Armour of Moonbasking

effects.name: Lunar Bestial Vitality
effects.text: You gain 22 temporary hit points after casting Wild Shape. While those temporary hit points are active reduce all incoming damage by 1.

effects.name: Lunar Bestial Fortitude
effects.text: While in Wild Shape, you have a +2 bonus to Armour Class and Advantage on saving throws against spells.

Armour of Moonbasking.description: This armour was designed by lunar-obsessed Cuthbertina, a gnomish arcane smith…

Birthright.name: Birthright

effects.text: Charisma +2 (to a maximum of 22).

Birthright.description: The thing that you poor sods simply cannot grasp is how effortless all this magical hootie-wootie castie-spellsie business…

Boots of Stormy Clamour.name: Boots of Stormy Clamour

effects.name: Arcane Echomalefaction
effects.text: When the wearer inflicts a condition upon a hostile creature, they also inflict 2 turns of Reverberation.

Boots of Stormy Clamour.description: Peals of thunder rumble at the back of your skull with every step taken in these boots.

Bow of Awareness.name: Bow of Awareness

effects.name: Seldom Caught Unawares (+1)
effects.text: You gain a +1 bonus to Initiative rolls.

grants.name: Hamstring Shot
grants.text: Action; recharges on Short Rest. Shoot an enemy in the thigh and possibly reduce their movement speed by 50%.

Bow of Awareness.description: This halfling bow requires a full draw for smaller folk, but serves as a quick off-hand for those of greater height.

Broodmother's Revenge.name: Broodmother's Revenge

effects.name: Venomous Revenge
effects.text: When the wearer is healed, their weapon is coated in magic and deals an extra 1d6 Poison damage for 3 turns.

Broodmother's Revenge.description: Each of this amulet's jewels shines like a viper's eyes.

Callous Glow Ring.name: Callous Glow Ring

effects.name: Callous Glow
effects.text: The wearer deals an additional 2 points of Radiant damage against creatures that are illuminated.

Callous Glow Ring.description: A grudging gleam emits from this ring - more an indictment of light than an endorsement.

Cindermoth Cloak.name: Cindermoth Cloak

effects.name: Flaming Shroud
effects.text: A creature that damages the wearer within 2 m (7 ft) receives Burning for 2 turns (1d4 Fire damage per turn; DC 12 Dexterity saving throw).

Cindermoth Cloak.description: With every rustle of this cloak, small moths like windblown embers appear around you.

Cloak of Displacement.name: Cloak of Displacement

effects.name: Displacement
effects.text: At the beginning of the wearer's turn, the cloak activates, granting enemies Disadvantage on Attack Rolls that target the wearer. Lasts until the wearer takes damage.

Cloak of Displacement.description: The fur is so blue as to be almost black. When mantled across your shoulders, the patterns on the cloak seem to shift and ripple.

Cloak of Protection.name: Cloak of Protection

effects.text: Armour Class +1
Saving Throw +1

Cloak of Protection.description: Otiluke and Bigby, members of the Circle of Eight, once made a bet: Bigby bet Otiluke that he couldn't suck thirteen litres of vodka out of a protection cloak like this one. Bigby won.

Cloak of the Weave.name: Cloak of the Weave

effects.name: Arcane Enchantment (+1)
effects.text: You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.

grants.name: Absorb Elements
grants.text: Reaction, once per Short Rest. Take half damage from the next elemental attack targeting you and deal an additional 1d6 of that element type on your next attack.

Cloak of the Weave.description: Part of an outfit worn by the wizard Tenser when he was inducted into the organization of eminent wizards called the Circle of Eight.

Coldbrim Hat.name: Coldbrim Hat

effects.name: Coldbrim Chill
effects.text: Once per turn, any condition inflicted on a target, also applies 2 turns of Encrusted with Frost.

Coldbrim Hat.description: Upturning the hat and gazing into it, you get this slightly vertiginous feeling.

Coruscation Ring.name: Coruscation Ring

effects.name: Arcane Radiance
effects.text: When the wearer deals spell damage while illuminated by a light source, they also inflict Radiating Orb upon the target for 2 turns.

Coruscation Ring.description: Provocative light blooms from the engraved contours of this ring.

Crusher's Ring.name: Crusher's Ring

effects.text: Movement Speed increased by 3 m (10 ft).

Crusher's Ring.description: Though caked with mud and grime, the ring smells faintly of lavender. Remarkable, considering where it's been.

Disintegrating Night Walkers.name: Disintegrating Night Walkers

effects.name: Night Walker
effects.text: The affected creature cannot be Enwebbed, Entangled, or Ensnared and cannot slip on Grease or Ice.

grants.name: Misty Step
grants.text: Bonus Action; level 2 spell; recharges on Short Rest

Disintegrating Night Walkers.description: Darker than a starless night, Night Walkers are made for secrecy in the honour of Shar.

Gloves of Belligerent Skies.name: Gloves of Belligerent Skies

effects.name: Thunderous Conversion
effects.text: When the wearer deals Thunder, Lightning, or Radiant damage, inflict 2 turns of Reverberation upon the target(s).

Gloves of Belligerent Skies.description: Balling your fingers into fists while wearing these gloves causes a sonorous chime, like a tempest and a church bell ringing inside your skull.

Haste Helm.name: Haste Helm

effects.name: Smooth Start
effects.text: At the start of combat, the wearer gains Momentum for 3 turns.

effects.name: Momentum
effects.text: Spurred on by a sense of urgency. Movement Speed increased by 1.5 m (5 ft) for each remaining turn of the effect; ends if the wearer becomes Restrained, Incapacitated, Prone or slowed.

Haste Helm.description: The helm throbs when violence is near, filling the wearer with a compulsion to act.

Holy Lance Helm.name: Holy Lance Helm

effects.text: +1 bonus to Constitution Saving Throws.

effects.name: Smite the Graceless
effects.text: Creatures who miss their Attack Rolls against the wearer must succeed a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take 1d4 Radiant damage.

Holy Lance Helm.description: Brief halos of divine light wrap your head when you don and doff this helmet.

Hood of the Weave.name: Hood of the Weave

effects.name: Arcane Enchantment (+2)
effects.text: You gain a +2 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.

Hood of the Weave.description: Worn by the Tenser when he was inducted into the Circle of Eight.

Justiciar's Scimitar.name: Justiciar's Scimitar

effects.name: Shadow-Blinding
effects.text: If you attack with Advantage, you have a chance to Blind your target.

effects.name: Shadow Blade
effects.text: You have Advantage on Attack Rolls against Lightly or Heavily Obscured targets when using this blade.

grants.name: Shadowsoaked Blow
grants.text: Action. Strike an enemy, adding your proficiency bonus to the damage; on a hit deals an additional 1d6 Psychic. Doesn't break concealment. Once per Short Rest.

grants.name: Backbreaker
grants.text: Weapon action. Action, once per Short Rest. Put extra force behind your strike to possibly knock your enemy Prone.

grants.name: Flourish
grants.text: Weapon action. Bonus Action, once per Short Rest. Feint an attack to possibly throw your opponent Off Balance.

Justiciar's Scimitar.description: This light, curved blade is as unusual and unforgiving as the Darkness it strikes from.

Ketheric's Shield.name: Ketheric's Shield

effects.text: Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws.

effects.name: Arcane Enchantment (+1)
effects.text: You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.

effects.name: Shield Bash
effects.text: When a foe hits the wearer with a melee attack, the wearer can use a reaction to knock them Prone unless they succeed a Dexterity saving throw.

grants.name: Shield Bash
grants.text: Reaction, triggered when hit by a melee attack.

Ketheric's Shield.description: In the theatre of dreams, Ketheric killed his wife every night.

Key of the Ancients.name: Key of the Ancients

effects.text: +1 bonus to Nature checks.
While standing in front of the stone door in Nettie's room in the Druid Grove, the wearer can open a shortcut to the Underground Passage.

Key of the Ancients.description: The branches of this circlet are half-fossilised, passed down through generations of druids.

Luminous Armour.name: Luminous Armour

effects.name: Radiating Shockwave
effects.text: When the wearer deals Radiant damage, they cause a Radiant Shockwave.

Luminous Armour.description: Many an adventurer has found themselves swallowed up by the dark throat of some nameless dungeon, aching for a glimpse of light.

Markoheshkir.name: Markoheshkir

effects.name: Arcane Enchantment (+1)
effects.text: You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.

effects.name: Arcane Battery
effects.text: Alleviate the arcane burden of spellcasting with the power of this staff. The next spell you cast doesn't cost a spell slot.

grants.name: Kereska's Favour
grants.text: Action, once per Short Rest. Imbue yourself with elemental energy sourced from the draconic goddess, Kereska.

grants.name: Topple
grants.text: Weapon action. Action, once per Short Rest. Swipe at a creature to knock it Prone.

Markoheshkir.description: Kereska, draconic goddess of arcane knowledge, imbues many chromatic dragons with their magic.

Melf's First Staff.name: Melf's First Staff

effects.name: Arcane Enchantment (+1)
effects.text: You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.

grants.name: Melf's Acid Arrow
grants.text: Level 2 spell. Action, once per Long Rest.

grants.name: Topple
grants.text: Weapon action. Action, once per Short Rest. Swipe at a creature to knock it Prone.

Melf's First Staff.description: In spite of (or perhaps because of) his suspiciously amusing name, the wizard Melf was actually quite a talented spellcaster and innovator in the field of the arcane.

Mourning Frost.name: Mourning Frost

effects.name: Heart of Ice
effects.text: When dealing Cold damage, the wielder deals an additional 1 Cold.

effects.name: Insidious Cold
effects.text: Dealing Cold damage with a spell possibly inflicts Chilled upon the target.

grants.name: Ray of Frost
grants.text: Cantrip, castable at will. Action.

grants.name: Topple
grants.text: Weapon action. Action, once per Short Rest. Swipe at a creature to knock it Prone.

Mourning Frost.description: The air around this staff crackles with a cold, frosty wind - a power that has been divided for too long, and is waiting to be released.

Necklace of Elemental Augmentation.name: Necklace of Elemental Augmentation

effects.name: Elemental Augmentation
effects.text: When one of your cantrips deals Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage, add your Spellcasting Modifier to the damage dealt.

Necklace of Elemental Augmentation.description: The tourmaline in this necklace is almost uncomfortably hot, warmed by a heat all its own.

Potent Robe.name: Potent Robe

effects.text: Armour Class +1

effects.name: Gregarious Caster
effects.text: Your cantrips deal additional damage equal to your Charisma Modifier.

effects.name: Well-Liked and Well-Fortified
effects.text: At the start of the wearer's turn, the robe activates, granting them Temporary Hit Points equal to their Charisma Modifier.

Potent Robe.description: This robe is a difficult look to pull off unless one is blessed with an otherwordly charisma.

Ring of Mental Inhibition.name: Ring of Mental Inhibition

effects.name: Mental Inhibition
effects.text: When a foe fails a Saving Throw against one of your spells or actions, they gain Mental Fatigue for 2 turns.

Ring of Mental Inhibition.description: The patterns in the ring's swirling metal make your head spin whenever you look at them for too long.

Ring of Protection.name: Ring of Protection

effects.text: Armour Class +1
Saving Throw +1

Ring of Protection.description: Elegant motifs of warding - shields, targes, bucklers, and buffers - are faintly impressed into the metal round of the ring.

Ring of Regeneration.name: Ring of Regeneration

effects.name: Combat Regeneration
effects.text: At the beginning of your turn, the ring activates and heals you 1d4 Hit Points.

Ring of Regeneration.description: This ring is, in effect, a tiny field medic that won't charge you 70 gold pieces for a fifteen-minute consultation.

Robe of the Weave.name: Robe of the Weave

effects.text: Armour Class +2

effects.name: Arcane Enchantment
effects.text: You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls.

effects.name: Weave Eater
effects.text: Whenever the wearer succeeds a Saving Throw against a spell, they regain 1d6 Hit Points.

Robe of the Weave.description: Earnest little Edith Cluckle was a small girl when she asked to be the great wizard Otiluke's apprentice.

Safeguard Shield.name: Safeguard Shield

effects.text: Saving Throws +1

Safeguard Shield.description: Magic got caught in this heirloom by being exposed to too many wizard family dinners.

Scimitar +1.name: Scimitar +1

grants.name: Flourish
grants.text: Bonus Action; recharges on Short Rest. Feint an attack to possibly knock the target Off Balance.

grants.name: Lacerate
grants.text: Action; recharges on Short Rest. Strike at the target's vital points to make it Bleed.

Scimitar +1.description: The phases of the moon are carved into the hilt of this scimitar, betraying a druid's careful hand.

Sentinel Shield.name: Sentinel Shield

effects.name: Heightened Awareness
effects.text: Gain a +3 bonus to Initiative rolls and Advantage on Perception Checks.

grants.name: Shield Blow
grants.text: Reaction. When struck by a melee attack, your attacker must succeed a Dexterity Saving Throw or fall Prone.

Sentinel Shield.description: Clever enchantments dance between the grooves of this shield, which emanates a magic of heightened awareness.

Shapeshifter Hat.name: Shapeshifter Hat

effects.text: Nature +1

effects.name: Nature's Embrace
effects.text: Increase your Wild Shape Charge by 1. This additional charge is restored upon taking a Long Rest.

Shapeshifter Hat.description: Trust is the most fundamental part of wild-shaping. Not trusting others, but trusting yourself.

Snowburst Ring.name: Snowburst Ring

effects.name: Snowburst
effects.text: When the wearer deals Cold damage, they also create a 4.5 m (15 ft) circle of Ice around the target(s).

Snowburst Ring.description: A series of names have been scratched out, one after the other, on the inside of the ring. The last word, untouched, is not a name. It simply reads: Mine.

Spellcrux Amulet.name: Spellcrux Amulet

grants.name: Spell Slot Restoration
grants.text: Replenish an expended spell slot of any level. Bonus Action, once per Long Rest.

Spellcrux Amulet.description: Some scholars have speculated that spells have a mind of their own, suggesting that the spells get bored…

The Graceful Cloth.name: The Graceful Cloth

effects.name: Cat's Grace
effects.text: You gain Cat's Grace and increase your Dexterity by 2, to a maximum of 20. Cat's Grace grants Advantage on Dexterity Checks and halves falling damage.

effects.name: Nimble As a Cat
effects.text: You gain a +1 bonus to your Dexterity Saving Throws and also increase your Jump distance by 1.5 m (5 ft).

The Graceful Cloth.description: A garment worn by one of three monks who fought together against Headless Serpent, Secret Venom, a gang in the port city of Nyanzaru. This was worn by Roahton Mobar, whose stances were broad and strong.

The Protecty Sparkswall.name: The Protecty Sparkswall

effects.name: High Spellcasting
effects.text: +1 bonus to Spell Save DC.

effects.name: Sparkswall Armour
effects.text: +1 bonus to Armour Class and Saving Throws while the wearer has Lightning Charges.

The Protecty Sparkswall.description: Yrre the Sparkstruck was raised in the Underdark, so they weren't surprised that power begets envy…

The Shadespell Circlet.name: The Shadespell Circlet

effects.name: Shadespell
effects.text: While the wearer is obscured in shadow, their spells gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC, making them more likely to succeed.

The Shadespell Circlet.description: One of the relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children. Flanked by her court, Duerra shook her head at her children…

The Spellsparkler.name: The Spellsparkler

effects.name: Electric Veins
effects.text: When the wielder deals damage with a spell or cantrip, they gain 2 Lightning Charges.

grants.name: Topple
grants.text: Swipe at a creature to knock it Prone. Action; recharges on Short Rest.

The Spellsparkler.description: Yrre the Sparkstruck intended to give the Spellsparkler to Lenore, a cleric of Mystra and old lover…

The Whispering Promise.name: The Whispering Promise

effects.name: Blessed Mercy
effects.text: When you heal a creature, it gains a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws for 2 turns.

The Whispering Promise.description: A soft, soothing voice floats from this ring, reciting a prayer over and over.

Thunderskin Cloak.name: Thunderskin Cloak

effects.name: Dazing Echo
effects.text: When a creature with Reverberation damages the wearer, that creature must succeed a DC 13 Constitution Saving Throw or become Dazed.

Thunderskin Cloak.description: Through a gap in the long snarls of thread, you are sure you can glimpse a great black thunderhead…

Titanstring Bow.name: Titanstring Bow

effects.name: Titan Weapon
effects.text: This weapon deals additional damage equal to your Strength Modifier.

grants.name: Brace (Ranged)
grants.text: Spend 6 m (20 ft) of movement; ranged damage rolls are rolled twice, using the higher result, for the rest of the turn. Recharges on Short Rest.

grants.name: Hamstring Shot
grants.text: Shoot an enemy in the thigh, possibly halving their movement speed. Action; recharges on Short Rest.

grants.name: Pushing Attack (Ranged)
grants.text: Push the target 4.5 m (15 ft) away. Action; recharges on Short Rest.

Titanstring Bow.description: The commonly held belief that archers are rangey, thin-wristed people is completely false. It takes years of training to pull a bowstring all the way back to your cheekbone, and wrists like iron.

Viconia's Walking Fortress.name: Viconia's Walking Fortress

effects.name: Spellguard
effects.text: You have Advantage on Saving Throws against spells. Spell attack rolls against you have Disadvantage.

effects.name: Rebuke of the Mighty
effects.text: When a foe hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to deal 2d4 Force damage; the attacker is knocked Prone unless they pass a Dexterity Saving Throw.

grants.name: Reflective Shell
grants.text: A protective shell reflects any projectiles targeted at you back to their point of origin. Bonus Action; recharges on Short Rest.

grants.name: Warding Bond
grants.text: Ward an ally: resistance to all damage and +1 to Armour Class and Saving Throws. Action; recharges on Long Rest.

Viconia's Walking Fortress.description: 'Walking Fortress' is a defensive technique reliant on a shield of this caliber…

Winter's Clutches.name: Winter's Clutches

effects.name: Winter's Clutches
effects.text: When the wearer deals Cold damage, they inflict 2 turns of Encrusted with Frost upon the target(s).

Winter's Clutches.description: Likely originated in Icewind Dale, where tempers run as hot as hearths, and frozen rivers trace the arm of the dale…
